title: RunManifest
description: A run's, a round's or a case's manifest.json, schema v5 (docs/zarr-profile.md, "Manifest"; docs/contribution/delivery.md): one entry per bundle naming its deliveries, every path relative to the manifest. The readers' own checks: that model and product name a registered dataset and forecastHours is the run's, that the core bundles are present on a live run, that variable names are unique, that every artifact path is unique in the manifest except a shared store's (a map store or segment whose final path component is bundles.zarr or bundles.<tier>.zarr, <tier> lowercase letters other than series), that an entry or a tier carries its container (path, byteLength and crc32 together) or a zarr store or both, that a segmented store carries no path or crc32 of its own and its byteLength is its segments' sum, and that a poster's metadataJson parses (as bundle-metadata.schema.json).

model.description: The dataset's manifest model, as bundle metadata names it (GFS, ECMWF, NOAA-MRMS, ...).

forecastHours.description: The run's last lead, in whole hours rounded up.

Timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC, to the second, with a Z suffix.

Crc32.description: CRC-32 (IEEE) as eight lowercase hex digits: the ?v= an object is fetched under.

Bundle.description: One bundle of the run. A bundle that ships the container carries path, byteLength and crc32; one that ships only its store carries zarr.

variable.description: The bundle id: a name, not a registered number; a reader skips one it does not draw.

ContainerPath.description: A relative .xue path with no .. component.

Variant.description: One reduced-resolution tier: its grid size, the bandwidth sustaining playback, and its container, its store or both.

bandwidth.description: Bits per second to sustain 12 fps playback while downloading the whole tier.

Poster.description: The first frame at reduced resolution, painted before the bundle arrives; metadataJson is the bundle's metadata on the poster grid, as a string.

Zarr.description: A bundle's or a tier's map store: one store, or a rolling window's segments (docs/zarr-profile.md, "Segmented stores").

MapStore.description: A map store: the store's root directory, the bytes this bundle reads in it, and the CRC-32 of its group document.

SegmentedStore.description: A map store cut along time: the segments in ascending time order, and byteLength their sum.

Segment.description: One segment store; its path may climb out of the manifest's directory with at most two leading .. components, and nowhere else.

SeriesStore.description: The bundle's series store (docs/zarr-profile.md, "Series store"): full resolution only, never shared, never segmented.

Grid.description: The bundle's full grid, as its metadata's grid block says it: written on entries whose readers locate a cell without opening the store.
